name: bigint64array
source: let x=BigInt('9'.repeat(8192)); let a=new BigInt64Array(2); a[0]=x; a[1]=-x; String(a[0])+','+String(a[1])

name: biguint64array
source: let x=BigInt('9'.repeat(8192)); let a=new BigUint64Array([x,-x]); String(a[0])+','+String(a[1])

name: dataview_modular
source: let x=BigInt('9'.repeat(2048)); let d=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(16)); d.setBigInt64(0,x,true); d.setBigUint64(8,-x,false); String(d.getBigInt64(0,true))+','+String(d.getBigUint64(8,false))

name: coercion_order
source: let log=[]; let b={valueOf(){log.push('bits');return 64}}; let v={valueOf(){log.push('value');return BigInt('9'.repeat(512))}}; let n=BigInt.asIntN(b,v); log.join(',')+':'+n

name: zero_number_rejected
source: let out='none'; try { BigInt.asUintN(0,1) } catch(e) { out=e.name } out

name: width_refusal_precedes_value
source: let n=0; let v={valueOf(){n++;return 1n}}; let out='none'; try { BigInt.asUintN(-1,v) } catch(e) { out=e.name } out+':'+n
